CustomField.description: The Balance Still Owing for this Performance
CustomField.formula: IF(ISBLANK(Deposit_Paid__c), ((Subtotal__c - Discount_Amount__c - Credit_Notes__c) * (1 - Deposit__c)) + (((Subtotal__c - Discount_Amount__c - Credit_Notes__c) * (1 - Deposit__c)) * VAT__c) - Balances_Received__c, Total_Incl_VAT__c-Balances_Received__c- Deposits_Received__c )
CustomField.label: Balance still due
